root_cause.text: The `tap_get_user_xdp()` function fails to free the page allocated by `vhost_net_build_xdp()` on error paths (frame too short or `build_skb()` failure), leading to a memory leak because the caller `tap_sendmsg()` discards the return value and never reclaims the page.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `put_page(virt_to_head_page(xdp->data))` on both error paths (the `ETH_HLEN` check and the `build_skb` failure), and the commit description explicitly states: "Both paths jump to the err label without freeing the page that vhost_net_build_xdp() allocated for the frame." and "each rejected frame in a batch leaks one page-frag chunk."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a page reference leak in tap_get_user_xdp() when xdp data is too short.
intent_record.what: Added put_page(virt_to_head_page(xdp->data)) before the goto err when xdp->data_end - xdp->data < ETH_HLEN.
intent_record.how: Prevents a page reference leak by releasing the page before jumping to the error handling label.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix page reference leak on build_skb failure in tap_get_user_xdp.
intent_record.what: Added put_page(virt_to_head_page(xdp->data)) in the error handling block when build_skb returns NULL in tap_get_user_xdp.
intent_record.how: This ensures the page backing the XDP buffer is released when skb allocation fails, preventing a memory leak.
